entities.name: Kefnet's Monument
entities.description: A legendary artifact and sacred site in Naktamun built for Kefnet, a pyramid crowned with his neck and beak that hosts the Trial of Knowledge.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The Amonkhet god of knowledge who demands intellect above all and greets initiates at the Trial of Knowledge.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Kefnet's Monument stands.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet above which Kefnet's Monument towers.

entities.name: Luxa
entities.description: The river into whose bed Kefnet's Monument is built.

entities.name: Desert of the Mindful
entities.description: The desert in Naktamun where Kefnet's Monument stands.

entities.name: Knowing's Knot
entities.description: The sprawling maze of illusions inside the monument.

entities.name: Infinite Puzzle
entities.description: An elaborate puzzle box just inside the entrance that Kefnet uses as a teaching tool; no one has reached its core.

entities.name: Trial of Knowledge
entities.description: Kefnet's contribution to the God Trials, held in the monument's labyrinth.

entities.name: God Trials
entities.description: The series of trials that initiates complete on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Trial of Solidarity
entities.description: The trial initiates must pass before training for the Trial of Knowledge.

entities.name: Kefnet's viziers
entities.description: Servants of Kefnet who manage the water, train initiates and sometimes attempt the Infinite Puzzle's final layers.

entities.name: Aven mummies
entities.description: Mummies that carry initiates up to the trial entrance.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler whose distant statue stands near the Second Sun's resting place.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: A sun by whose light new events are carved into the monument each night.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: A magical event whose magic is similar to that sustaining the labyrinth.

events.summary: After training with Kefnet or his viziers, initiates arrive at the Trial of Knowledge, where Kefnet greets them and dulls their physical instincts.
events.quote: Kefnet greets them himself, then casts a spell that dulls their muscle memory and physical instincts

events.summary: Initiates navigate the illusory labyrinth, facing nightmare visions; failures die and are carried out by mummies.
events.quote: Initiates encounter spectral creatures shaped by their worst nightmares

events.summary: Initiates who learn the glyph spell find the true exit and are rewarded by Kefnet with their cartouches.
events.quote: Kefnet waits to reward them with their cartouches

events.summary: Kefnet's viziers who reach the final layers of the Infinite Puzzle glimpse the afterlife and are rewarded with a glorified death.
events.quote: Kefnet rewards them with a glorified death

relations.quote: built in honor of the god of knowledge

relations.note: Manage the water and train initiates for him.
relations.quote: The water, managed by Kefnet's viziers
Towering above the city of Naktamun
